brief.goal: Choose a code animation approach that GPT-6 Astra with ultra effort can use for detailed, scientifically credible fire-ant scenes matched to the already approved 78.602449-second Tyler narration.
brief.output: Short plain-English recommendation, comparison, future installation checklist, primary-source evidence and explicit unknowns, saved in the project's research folder. No implementation or installations.
questions: Which candidate has the strongest published code and examples for textured illustrated ants and underground nest scenes?
How can the first trial preserve fire-ant biology, reuse the approved narration, and produce 1080x1920 vertical scenes in Deep Six colors?
What exactly would the first option and one backup require locally, and what costs, license conditions or setup limits apply?
What remains unverified without installing or rendering, and what should a small first trial demonstrate?
scope_constraints: User chose option A: illustrated science book, detailed bugs, textured scenery and clear underground views for homeowners.
Keep approved narration and hook unchanged. Main lesson graphics must be drawn and animated in code. Vertical 9:16, 1080x1920; Deep Six lime, purple, cream and dark outlines.

Use earlier project animation findings as leads, not as proof. Verify actual primary repositories, source code, examples and documentation. Candidate leads include buildwithhanif/claude-animation-skill, Remotion, Motion Canvas, HyperFrames, HandDraw and other relevant leads from the user's list.
Public sources only. No installs, rendering, browser automation, cookies, login to source sites, paid services, publishing or project changes beyond research artifacts.
Crawler mode is caller-driven; no crawler model calls. Free public search and reading only. Do not treat repository claims or literal quote matching as independent quality or biology validation.
Recommend one first setup and one backup; do not build a full production system or modify the crawler.

notes.content: Selected A (illustrated science book), then explicitly answered yes to the displayed research plan: compare strongest animation options using the MacBook Crawler; assess look, biology, vertical output and narration timing; recommend first setup and backup with requirements/costs/limits; save findings, links and unknowns.

Preliminary public scouting found an ant-colony code example and textured illustration helpers at https://github.com/buildwithhanif/claude-animation-skill ; general engines https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion and https://github.com/motion-canvas/motion-canvas ; HandDraw README https://github.com/ToBeWin/HandDraw-Skill focuses on whiteboard animation. These are leads, not tested recommendations. Operational ceilings chosen for this bounded free research: 30 page attempts, 4 searches, 80 actions, 900 active seconds. The API requires calls >=1, but this agent-driven run makes zero model calls.

snapshot.original_goal: Research a practical first setup for code-created illustrated science-book-style Deep Six pest-education videos, then recommend one first trial and one backup without installing, changing application files or spending money.
